sloka: व्यस्फुरन्नयनं चास्य सव्यं युद्धाभिनन्दिनः ।विवर्णो मुखवर्णश्च गद्गदश्चाभवत् स्वनः ।। ६.५५.१० ।।।।
transliteration: vyasphurannayanaṁ cāsya savyaṁ yuddhābhinandinaḥ ।vivarṇo mukhavarṇaśca gadgadaścābhavat svanaḥ ।। 6.55.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Himself being a lover of war, became pale with his countenance changed, voice choked, and his eyes lost its lustre.
